messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: convert from feaure to meta-feature
parts:
I'm afraid there is no way to correctly convert the feature level counts into meta-feature level. Adding counts to all the features belonging to the same meta-feature doesn't give you the correct meta-feature level counts since a read may be counted multiple times (if multi-assignment was allowed in feature-level counting) or wrongly discarded (if multi-assignment was disallowed in feature-level counting). 

The proper way is to re-run featureCounts on the meta-feature mode.
